h: וַיֵּלֶךְ וְשַׁבַּת תְּשׁוּבָה, י״ט Vayeilech and Shabbos Shuvah, 19

p: It is stated in the Gemara, Yoma
for it reaches up to the Throne of Glory,
'Return, O Israel, unto Hashem your God'"
why it needed to bring a proof from the Prophets,
when this very expression is found
in the holy Torah as well,
"And you shall return unto Hashem your God," etc.
"and you shall listen to His voice."
For the meaning of "unto Hashem your God"
is that this is the essence of teshuvah:
regarding the fact that there has become distant from a person's heart
the holy Name Havayah, blessed be He.
For this is the essence and foundation of everything:
that this belief be fixed in the soul,
that Havayah, blessed be He, is Elokim.
whose meaning is that He is mighty and all-capable
this is easy for a person's heart
But the aspect of the Name Havayah,
and is Master of all the forces,
and all the forces are nothing apart from Him,
who was, is, and will be,
וְאַתָּה הוּא עַד שֶׁלֹּא נִבְרָא הָעוֹלָם
and "You were the same before the world was created,
and You are the same since the world was created" —
it is hard for this to become fixed
because he sees the opposite appearance.
And for this reason the first utterance
which is the general principle of the entire Torah:
that this belief be fixed in the heart,
"Know this day and lay it to your heart
And at the time of Matan Torah
this became fixed with clear knowledge,
perceptibly, in all the souls of Yisrael;
and as they of blessed memory said
the utterance 'I am Hashem your God,'
the words of Torah became fixed in their hearts."
וְגַם אַחַר זֶה נִיתַּן כָּל הַתּוֹרָה
And also after this the whole Torah was given
as six hundred and thirteen counsels,
and become distant, in hester panim,
from His providence, blessed be He —
for him it is extremely hard
to fix this belief in his soul,
since he has inclined in his deeds
toward the aspect opposite to this.
"and you shall return unto Hashem your God,"
"and you shall listen to His voice":
that is, through hearing the voice
there will return to his soul
namely through the six hundred and thirteen counsels,
However, in Hoshea it says without qualification
"Return, O Israel, unto Hashem your God":
it is possible to reach back again
to the aspect of "Hashem your God"
from the depths of the heart,
as is stated in the holy Zohar
for in one hour, in one moment,
they are close to the Holy One, blessed be He."
Therefore the Gemara cited above brings
the proof that great is teshuvah,
for it reaches up to the Throne of Glory,
that is, that through teshuvah alone
one can reach up to the Throne of Glory,
meaning to the aspect of "Hashem your God";
and this is learned specifically from Hoshea,
